title: Weak stability for the total-degree absolute value
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $n\ge1$, and let $Q=\operatorname{Frac}(F[X_1,\ldots,X_n])$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Equip $Q$ with the multiplicative nonarchimedean absolute value $|0|_t=0$ and $|f/g|_t=\exp(\deg f-\deg g)$ for nonzero polynomials $f,g$, where $\deg$ is total degree. For every finite field extension $L/Q$ and every $Q$-basis $w_1,\ldots,w_r$ of $L$, its minimal-polynomial spectral norm $s=s_{L/Q}$ [lem-trf-incomplete-spectral-algebra-norm] satisfies $$c\max_i|a_i|_t\ \le\ s(\sum_i a_iw_i)\ \le\ C\max_i|a_i|_t\qquad(a_i\in Q)$$ for some real constants $c,C>0$. No perfection of $F$, separability of $L/Q$, or completeness of $Q$ is assumed.
